title: release r18: GB/T 47236-2026 ingested + first regulation-driven hazard batch (652 hazards)
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- GB/T 47236-2026 fully ingested into the V4 knowledge graph: law identity, version, evidence and 102 verified clauses (verbatim check against archived official fulltext; 22 heading-only candidates and 6 tables intentionally skipped).
- New tools/v4/generate_hazards_from_clauses.py implements the V4.1 regulation-driven inversion (clause -> hazard + direct link + full review chains). Batch 1: 24 hazards generated from the standard general safety requirements.
- Real-time gate: eligibleHazards 628 -> 652, eligibleLinks 806 -> 830, strictBlockers=0. Site now serves r18 (652 hazards / 173 laws / 186 clauses / 830 links, releaseHash a59c8380...).
